note: Demo output showing the selection mechanism end-to-end. This is a design BRIEF (structured instructions), not a rendered image -- no image-generation/export tool exists in this repo yet (apps/dashboard, apps/worker, packages/renderer are all still empty .gitkeep placeholders). See README.md 'What's missing' for what would be needed to render this.

reference_guide_used.why: Picked for its dense, clearly-ranked typography scale (17 named steps from hero-display to micro) and a generous, evenly-doubling spacing rhythm -- both transfer well to an information-dense educational post that still needs a clear single focal headline. Not picked for its own visual identity (navy/purple/pastel), which is discarded entirely.

font_candidate.status: candidate in font-pool.json, not yet a locked channel typography decision -- flagging that, not presenting it as final
font_candidate.license: SIL Open Font License (Google Fonts) -- verified open, no purchase needed
font_candidate.turkish_support: IBM Plex Sans covers Latin Extended-A (includes i-dotless/I-dotted, g-breve, s/c-cedilla, o/u-umlaut) -- verified from the typeface's documented glyph set, not assumed from the name alone. No local font binary is vendored in this repo (loaded via Google Fonts at runtime on the website); a static file would need to be added before any local render tool could use it.
font_candidate.no_font_file_from_reference_repo: awesome-design-md supplies only a DESIGN.md text spec naming 'Notion Sans' -- that is Notion's own private commercial typeface, not distributed anywhere in that repo. It is not used here at all, by name or file.

layout_brief.note_on_scaling: Notion's own pixel values target a desktop web hero (up to 1440px+ wide); the ratios between steps (not the raw px) are what's actually reused, then scaled to fit a 1080px square social canvas -- copying the raw px values verbatim would be oversized for this format.
